title: LumenFalls
body:
**Lumenfall** is a medieval-themed modpack with only 34 carefully selected mods, offering immersive gameplay without compromising performance. Designed for builders, adventurers, and fantasy fans alike. 

---

🎮 6 Resource Packs And 1 Shader

🛠️ **Key Features**:

Explore ancient ruins, medieval towns, and forgotten dungeons.

Build castles and settlements with Default HD's realistic textures.

Battle enemies using medieval weapons and armor.

Experience a dark fantasy world brought to life with Solas Shader.

🎮 Perfect for survival, exploration, and roleplay.
✨ Optimized for low to mid-end PCs with high visual fidelity.

Whether you want to build a peaceful village or conquer the wild with sword and spell, Lumenfalls gives you the tools to forge your legend.
